exposure: Age of infant at blood collection (umbilical cord blood, 48-118 hours, 4 months, 12 months)
outcome: Red blood cell biomarker reference intervals (mean cell volume, erythrocyte counts, reticulocyte counts, reticulocyte haemoglobin, mean cell haemoglobin, mean cell haemoglobin concentration)
cohort: The study included 442 presumably healthy infants from three community-based populations in Sweden, all born at term with umbilical cord clamping delayed to 30 seconds or more after birth.
finding: The study defined mainly narrower reference intervals for haemoglobin and red blood cell biomarkers compared with previously published studies, demonstrating that intervals vary significantly with infant age.
